title: Cloud City: Performance Optimization: Bottlenecks, Caching & Scaling
city_concept: City Traffic Bottlenecks & Express Highway Lanes

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Every morning at 08:00, all cars and delivery trucks funnelled into a single one-lane cobblestone street, causing miles of gridlocked traffic.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Traffic Engineer Tilda built express bypass lanes (Cloud CDN) and neighborhood parking hubs (Memorystore) so local commuters never entered the center.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a stadium concert let out, automated traffic signals synchronized green lights (Predictive Autoscaling) to flush traffic in 10 minutes.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Paving physical bypass roads takes two years; configuring Cloud CDN edge caching takes 60 seconds via Cloud Console.
